Here’s a classic list of ingredients you’ll typically find in a traditional lasagna recipe: | Category | Typical Ingredients | |----------|---------------------| | **Lasagna Noodles** | • 9–12 sheets (regular or no‑boil) | | **Meat Sauce** | • 1 lb ground beef
• 1 lb Italian sausage (optional)
• 1 small onion, diced
• 2–3 cloves garlic, minced
• 1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce
• 1 can (15 oz) tomato paste
• 1 cup beef broth or water
• 1 tsp dried oregano
• 1 tsp dried basil
• ½ tsp dried thyme
• Salt & pepper to taste | | **Ricotta Layer** | • 15 oz ricotta cheese
• 1 egg (helps bind)
• ¼ cup grated Parmesan
• Pinch of nutmeg (optional)
• Salt & pepper | | **Mozzarella Layer** | • 2 cups shredded mozzarella (or a mix of mozzarella + provolone) | | **Parmesan Layer** | • ½–¾ cup grated Parmesan (for topping) | | **Optional Extras** | • 1 cup chopped spinach or sautéed mushrooms
• 1 tbsp fresh parsley or basil, chopped (for garnish) | Feel free to adjust quantities based on how many servings you’re making or your personal taste preferences!
